newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Fed leaves interest rates unchanged.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Fed leaves interest rates unchanged.

text.p: The U.S. Federal Reserve on Tuesday left key interest rates unchanged amid evidence the economy is growing at a comfortable speed with low inflation.

The announcement by the central bank's policy making Federal Open Market Committee left the key federal funds rate which banks charge each other for overnight loans steady at 5.5 percent, where it has been since March.
"The Federal Open Market Committee meeting ended at 12:40 p.m. (1640 GMT)," central bank spokesman Joe Coyne said. "There is no further announcement."
With recent data suggesting that growth is moderate and inflation steady in the world's largest economy, investors had expected the Fed to leave official interest rates unchanged.
The next meeting of the FOMC is set for Sept 30.
